title: Sleep and Cardiovascular Health in Adolescence

sections.abstract: Insomnia is a prevalent and under-recognized disorder in adolescence, particularly in girls, with long-term repercussions for mental and physical health. This study assesses manifestation of autonomic hyperarousal and vulnerability to insomnia using a sample of male and female adolescents with and without Diagnostic and Statistical Manual (DSM-5) Insomnia Disorder. Outcomes from this study have the potential to inform prevention and treatment interventions for insomnia that can be implemented at a young age before chronic negative sequelae of this common disorder manifest.
